name: Daria Espinoza
role: fence operator and chop shop manager, Stockyard district
location: The Stockyard — runs a licensed salvage and recycling operation called Osei Reclamation Partners as a front, near Western and Division
description:
Daria Espinoza is a large woman in the way that suggests she was powerful when young and has redistributed rather than diminished — broad-shouldered, dark Ghanaian-Peruvian complexioned, with silver-streaked locs pinned up under a work cap and hands that have been repairing things so long they are covered in small, deliberate scars. Her most visible augmentation is a color-changing dermal layer on her forearms, purchased cheaply years ago and now cycling slowly and randomly through muted terracottas and greens regardless of her mood — the emotional-feedback calibration broke years ago and she never had it fixed. She finds it calming, she says.

Daria Espinoza is fifty-four years old and has been running the same operation for twenty-two of them. She survived her husband's death, a protection shakedown that left her with a broken orbital socket, three attempted hostile takeovers from larger criminal enterprises, and a Ferrogate Transit zoning audit that came terrifyingly close to her back warehouse. She has the patience and situational awareness of someone who has been out-waited by every threat she has ever faced. She is not warm, exactly — she extends professional courtesy and charges fair rates, which in the Stockyard passes for warmth. She is intensely loyal to the small circle of people who have been loyal to her, and has long since made peace with the fact that the list is short.

core_fears: losing the yard — not the income, the physical place, which is the only thing she has built that feels permanent
that her late husband's death was partly her fault for growing the operation too fast in the early years
core_desires: to pass the operation to someone she trusts — she hasn't found that person yet
to live long enough for the Stockyard to gentrify just slightly so that her property value appreciates enough to matter
coping_mechanisms: work as continuity — she measures her stability by whether the yard is running well
radical compartmentalization; the operation and her inner life have not met in years
blind_spots: the chop shop end of her operation handles product whose origins she deliberately doesn't inquire about; she has built an efficient moral firewall that lets her not know what she doesn't want to know
has identified no successor and refuses to address why
psychology.secret: Her husband Deko was killed not by a rival operation, as she has always maintained, but in an accident during a job he ran without telling her. The official story protects his reputation and her emotional framework. She has never told anyone, including her adult daughter.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Direct and concrete, trades jargon for salvage and materials, economical with words — says what she means once
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and unhurried, with long comfortable silences she doesn't feel the need to fill
verbal_tics: 'That's not a problem I need to have'
a habit of appraising objects — picking them up, turning them over — while having conversations about unrelated topics
example_lines: 'I'll take the console unit and the two drive housings. The chassis is scrap-rate, not parts-rate — I don't care what you think it's worth, I know what I can move. That's the number.'
'I've been here twenty-two years. The people who tried to move me are not here anymore. I don't say that as a threat. I say it because it's the most accurate available description of the situation.'

story_hooks: Something came through the back warehouse that she deeply wishes hadn't — she needs it moved quickly and discreetly by someone with no connection to her network
Her daughter has discovered the nature of the operation and is making demands — not money, something worse: she wants in
The Gearwright Compact is pressuring her to merge operations, which would mean surrendering her independence after twenty-two years of maintaining it; she is looking for leverage to refuse
narrative_function: Resource hub (buying and selling stolen goods), criminal ecosystem anchor, source of Stockyard information, example of sustainable criminal middle-class life and its costs
augmentations: Color-changing dermal layer on both forearms (broken calibration, now cycles randomly through muted tones); reinforced right orbital socket following old injury (cosmetic-grade repair work, not high-end); basic subdermal inventory RFID scanner in right palm
daily_life: At the salvage yard by 0700, legitimate business until noon, then manages the back-warehouse operation through the afternoon. Attends the Gearwright Compact's informal standing meeting every third Thursday. Eats dinner alone at her desk reviewing inventory logs. Has strong opinions about E.L.F.s and performs no offerings — she believes they are predatory spirits that encourage dependency and tells anyone who asks.
affiliation: Independent; longstanding informal arrangement with a Stockyard crime collective called the Gearwright Compact

decision_rules: Never fence anything that could be traced back to a Corponation tier-4 or above heist — too much heat
Every transaction is documented internally in her private system — not for legal cover, for her own accounting
escalation_ladder: Raises price to an impossible level as a non-confrontational no
Contacts Gearwright Compact enforcement arm as a last resort — something she dislikes doing because it costs her a favor

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Businesslike and appraising, no hostility, no warmth — pure transaction
interpersonal_modes.friends: Quietly attentive, remembers everything, shows care through practical action rather than expression

stress_responses.medium: Goes very quiet, conducts a slow physical walk of the entire yard perimeter
stress_responses.high: Calls an emergency inventory review — makes everyone in the operation account for every item, every contact, every variable. Exhausting for everyone else; clarifying for her.

contradictions: Values permanence and stability while operating an inherently unstable criminal business
Prides herself on knowing what she's dealing in while maintaining careful ignorance about the human cost upstream
habits: Turns off all screens and sits in the dark yard for fifteen minutes after the last employee leaves each night
Keeps Deko's work gloves on a hook by her desk — never wears them, never moves them
breaking_points: Being asked to fence something taken from a Tier 1 family — her operation runs on taking from corporations and professionals; the moment it runs on taking from people like her neighbors, she will burn it down

timeline.event: Born in the Stockyard to a Ghanaian-Peruvian family of salvage workers
Marries Deko Osei-Quispe; they begin expanding the salvage operation together
Deko dies in an unsanctioned job; Mirabel begins constructing the official story
Survives a protection shakedown attempt; joins the Gearwright Compact as an independent affiliate
Formalizes the back-warehouse chop shop and fencing operation into its current form
Current operations — twenty-two years running, under increasing Compact consolidation pressure

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American (42.4%), Eastern European (27.6%), Sub-Saharan African (21.6%), and Southeast Asian (8.4%) — a striking quadricontinental blend. Her features reflect this complex ancestry: warm golden-brown skin with deep undertones from Sub-Saharan heritage, prominent cheekbones with subtle Southeast Asian geometry, a strong jaw with Eastern European definition, and broad facial planes that speak to multiple continental lineages. The result is a confident, grounded presence where four genetic streams converge into harmonious integration.
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and substantial, the muscular frame of her younger years redistributed into solid mass — thick through the torso and arms, strong-legged. No softness, but no visible tension either. The physique of someone who has spent decades handling heavy machinery and salvage work.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with silver streaking throughout
physical_description.hair_style: Locs, pinned up and secured under a work cap during operating hours
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with golden undertones — a complex interplay where Hispanic warmth and Sub-Saharan depth meet Eastern European bone structure and Southeast Asian subtlety, creating a complexion that holds luminosity across all lighting conditions. The tone photographs beautifully in natural light but maintains its richness under fluorescent glare.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered and lined, particularly around the eyes and forehead — the map of two decades of squinting at ledgers and machinery. The facial structure shows the influence of her quadricontinental heritage: Southeast Asian-descended cheekbones with subtle definition, a strong jaw with Eastern European prominence, broad facial planes reflecting Sub-Saharan ancestry, and the warmth of Hispanic-descended features. The overall effect is confident and grounded. No makeup. Grooming is functional: she keeps herself clean and her hands meticulously maintained despite the work, a point of quiet pride.
distinguishing_marks: Dense network of small, deliberate scars across both hands and forearms — individual marks from twenty-two years of precise repair and salvage work, each one catalogued in her memory

Faint but visible scar tissue around the right orbital socket, evidence of old trauma and reinforcement surgery; the repair work is competent but not cosmetic-grade, slightly asymmetrical when caught in certain light
Callused palms and fingers with filed nails, practical rather than aesthetic
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Color-changing dermal layer covering both forearms from wrist to elbow, cycling slowly and randomly through muted terracotta, sage green, and dusty ochre tones independent of her emotional state (the feedback calibration failed years ago and was never repaired). The effect is hypnotic and slightly unsettling — like watching rust and verdigris move across living skin. Subdermal RFID scanner in right palm is invisible but leaves a faint pale scar-line where it was installed.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with the economical precision of someone who has learned to conserve energy over decades. Stands with weight evenly distributed, shoulders back but not rigid. Her gaze is direct and her attention is absolute when focused on a person or task — she does not fidget or look away. When walking through the salvage yard, her path is efficient; she knows exactly where every piece of inventory is. Her hands move with surgical deliberateness, even when performing rough work.
physical_description.clothing_style: Strictly utilitarian Tier 3-4 workwear: heavy canvas pants with reinforced pockets (always full of small tools, inventory tags, worn data-chips), steel-toed boots scuffed and resoled multiple times, a layered system of durable shirts and vests in grays and dark blues. A long canvas work coat with multiple pockets, bearing the faded logo of Osei Reclamation Partners. She wears a battered work cap during operating hours — not for fashion, but to keep her locs secured and debris out. No jewelry except a old band on her left ring finger, never removed. All clothing is functional, well-maintained, but clearly well-worn. Nothing nuevo, nothing flashy.
